name: expense-api
description: Owns claims, policy rules and decisions. Creates and lists expense claims, checks each submitted claim against the active policy rules and raises a flag with a plain-language reason when one breaks, lists a manager's own team's pending claims, records approve/reject decisions, and lets Finance/Admin maintain policy rules and see claims across every team. It does not read receipt files itself — the webapp pre-fills claim fields via receipt-agent before calling this API — and it does not send any notification.
